Package org.apache.juneau.http.classic.header

Class HeaderList.Unmodifiable

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractList<E>
java.util.ArrayList<Header>
org.apache.juneau.http.classic.header.HeaderList
org.apache.juneau.http.classic.header.HeaderList.Unmodifiable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Header>, Collection<Header>, List<Header>, RandomAccess, UnmodifiableBean
Enclosing class:
HeaderList
public static class HeaderList.Unmodifiable extends HeaderList implements UnmodifiableBean
An unmodifiable snapshot of a HeaderList.

This is the D4 "collection-mutator-override" variant of the immutability paradigm. Because HeaderList extends ArrayList, a single modify() funnel cannot intercept the inherited ArrayList mutators, so this subclass snapshot-copies the elements in its constructor and overrides the entire collection-mutator surface — its own fluent mutators plus the inherited ArrayList mutators (including the iterator() / listIterator() mutators) — to throw UnsupportedOperationException. Read operations and non-mutating iteration continue to work.
